description: .NET 10 package that hosts a remote Blazor UI on Windows, Mac, and Linux
releaseNotes:
Based on maui 10.0.15.2

Changes since 10.0.14
Merge pull request #98 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-xv5i5s
Refuse GetIds on a relay that requires sign-in
Merge pull request #97 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-89es12
Mirror: wait for the WebView before showing the mirror on connect
Tests: say which session is short when the relay's file totals don't match
Merge pull request #96 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-89es12
Bump to 10.0.15.2 with release notes
Merge pull request #90 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-i544zb
Merge pull request #91 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-89es12
Merge pull request #94 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-wg41g7
Set-RailwayAgentKeys: create its link folder under -WhatIf too
Merge pull request #95 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-mj8jra
Set-RailwayAgentKeys: define a function when dot-sourced, link the relay project itself
Relay: send non-owner browsers in shared sessions to the mirror, log page requests
Relay: an EndSession is an expected disconnect, and keeps the requester label
Add scripts/Set-RailwayAgentKeys.ps1 to set the relay's enrollment keys on Railway
AgentHub: add ReleaseAvailableCommand broadcast and AgentAdmin.PublishRelease RPC
Merge pull request #93 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-3r4wyp-end-reason
Check connectionState in the lost-connection end-to-end test
Merge pull request #92 from budcribar/claude/project-thread-3r4wyp
Merge branch 'claude/project-thread-3r4wyp' into claude/project-thread-3r4wyp-end-reason
Tests: pass a shutdown reason in the null/whitespace id test
Relay: ReasonedCancellationTokenSource records why a session's token was cancelled
Relay: record why a session ends next to its token, so follow-on cancellations log at Debug
Relay: log every session shutdown with its reason
Publish the stream's connection state in window.RemoteControl
Relay: refuse agents outside Development when AGENT_ENROLLMENT_KEYS is unset
Merge pull request #88 from budcribar/claude/client-key
Agent protocol: add STAGE_CONSENT_TIMED_OUT launch stage (#89)
Relay: a browser that leaves straight after joining is taken out of the session
Relay: a request must carry the key of the connection it names
Merge pull request #87 from budcribar/claude/voice-controls-warning
Voice without controls is reported in the console
Relay: /status is open without sign-in and reports only a finished registration
Relay: the owner's own window is never locked out or taken for a refresh
Relay: EndSession RPC and a requester label for signed-in callers
Include RemoteTicket in Railway watchPatterns
Fix relay ticket signature interoperability with RemoteWebViewAdmin and fallback signing key
Fix unattended consent check for platform admins with null group scope
Support reading ticket from query parameter and set relay auth cookie
Add signed RemoteTicket relay authorization and tenant policy hooks
Add a Fast filter for the desktop and tutorial tests
Tests: wait for the relay's file totals before checking them
Merge branch 'claude/session-bar-opt-in': session bar is opt-in, templates, restart keeps the owner role (10.0.15.1)
A page comes back from a restart with the query it was opened with
Session bar is opt-in: no placeholder, no bar; a template makes it the app's own
Merge branch 'claude/session-bar-slot-declared': session bar waits for a declared placeholder (10.0.15.1)
Generator README and ShareControl doc comment mention the host-page tag for the session bar
Version 10.0.15.1 (was 10.0.16): the first three parts follow the .NET release
Test: visibility waits take their own options type
Session bar waits for a declared placeholder instead of floating at startup (10.0.16)
Release workflow publishes to NuGet when dry_run is off (trusted publishing, nuget-org approval)
10-client test waits 2 minutes before attaching browsers again (idle sessions must survive)

Full list: https://github.com/budcribar/RemoteBlazorWebView/compare/10.0.14...78554ab12c9890900cfa70e917c4ca8231fc7a17
